user: I dislike eating spicy food.
assistant:  It's perfectly okay to not enjoy spicy food. Everyone has different taste preferences and there is no right or wrong when it comes to personal preferences. Some people love the heat and flavor that spicy foods provide, while others, like yourself, may find it uncomfortable or overwhelming. If you're ever in a social situation where spicy food is being served, don't hesitate to ask for a milder version or request a different dish. It's important to be mindful of your own comfort and enjoyment. If you're cooking at home, you can always adjust recipes to suit your taste by reducing or omitting chili peppers or other spicy ingredients.
